name: Hiyama Kozue
source:
One of [url=https://vndb.org/c22211]Yuuji[/url]'s classmates and [url=https://vndb.org/c989]Misaki[/url]’s best friend of whom she is very protective of. She has quite a sharp mind and is rather savvy when it comes to technology. Kozue always seems to have a camera around so she could immortalize any moments involving her precious Misaki. Her family is quite rich but she doesn’t let that show.

[Edited from [url=http://animehistory.wordpress.com/2008/03/23/snow-sakura-visual-novel/]Anime History[/url]]
